> Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be differentiable with $f'(x_0)=0$. Then $x_0$ is a critical point, so $f$ attains its global minimum at $x_0$.
first_unsupported_step_markdown: "$`x_0`$ is a critical point, so $f$ attains its global minimum at $x_0$."
why_it_fails_markdown: Stationarity is a necessary condition for an interior minimum of a differentiable function, not a sufficient one.
